anchor.statement: Corollary B.6. There is t c > 0, with t c < t 1 and 4e t c < 4.1, such that the functions E/ √ 2X, U, V 0 /X, Π on [0, X 0 e t c] × [−1, 1] are smooth in (X, η ) through X = 0 and analytic in η on one complex neighborhood. Every fixed radial derivative of these four functions has that same parameter neighborhood and finite bounds on a smaller neighborhood. On X 0 < X ≤ X 0 e t c, the admissible stress cone condition and the factorization (B.30) hold. All subsequent profile modifications are supported strictly to the right of X 0 e t c.
